summary:
allowIfSubTypeIsArray() approving every array (`Evil[]`) regardless of element
type. BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator.Builder.allowIfSubTypeIsArray() was added in
2.10.1 (@since 2.10.1): 2.10.0 has no such method and no other matcher that
approves arrays as such, so an array type id is only accepted if a configured
name/class matcher accepts the array class itself. The type-parameter/array-component validation that upstream
added with the same fix ([databind#5988]) is applied here as CVE-2026-54512.
